cards.drag: Drag to reorder or move folder
cards.always: Always include this card in chats
cards.contentPlaceholder: What this card adds when triggered…
cards.generatePlaceholder: Paste text (a large system prompt, lore, notes…); the utility model splits it into trigger cards you can edit above.
cards.errorNoList: The model did not return a card list
cards.errorNoUsable: The model did not return any usable cards
